nits.finding: The row names still say merged-optin/merged-no-optin even though the active repair is branch-selected. Also, complete means all rows reached a conclusive classification; it may be true when the positive fails or a control is unexpected, while controls_intended is false.
nits.impact: The per-row verdicts and false accepted/proof_credit fields retain the distinction, but a successful helper exit or the word complete can be misread without checking those fields.
nits.suggestion: Use branch-selected row names or record an explicit variant per row, and document/rename complete as classification_complete so it cannot be mistaken for a passing proof matrix.
